item.title: Iran War Live Updates: U.S. Says It Bombed Key Iranian Island With Oil Hub
item.summary: President Trump said he directed the Pentagon to “totally obliterate” military assets on Kharg Island. The U.S. said it was deploying thousands of Marines to the region.

item.title: To Fight Iran’s Drones, U.S. Taps Ukraine’s Hard-Earned Knowledge
item.summary: As Iran has shown, warfare involves far more deadly projectiles than it once did. It’s a problem Ukraine has been dealing with for years.

item.title: How the War in Iran Could Help China and Change Asia
item.summary: American officials have said for years that they would prioritize the Indo-Pacific. Now they’re moving warships, missiles and air defenses out for a war in the Middle East.

item.title: A Visit to a Temple at the Heart of the Thailand-Cambodia Conflict
item.summary: A rare visit to a Khmer temple on Thailand and Cambodia’s border showed how deadly clashes between the two countries have scarred a heritage site.

item.title: U.S. Sanctions Pause Adds Political Win to Russia’s Economic Gain From Iran War
item.summary: Kremlin officials said the American move, which Europe opposes, showed that Moscow could not be dislodged from the center of global energy markets.

item.title: Iran’s Frantic Attempt to Save Its Ships Before Torpedo Attack
item.summary: The Iranian Navy sought refuge in Sri Lanka and India. While India obliged, Sri Lanka stalled over fears it would threaten its neutrality.

item.title: What to Know About Iran’s Kharg Island
item.summary: The Persian Gulf island, targeted by U.S. strikes, is home to Iran’s main oil export terminal. Any disruption could jolt global energy markets.

item.title: Trump’s War Alliance With Israel Is Reshaping the Middle East. But It Carries Risks.
item.summary: President Trump is the first American leader to embrace fighting a full-fledged, joint war with Israel. Washington has tried to avoid that level of coordination in the past.

item.title: Here’s What Happened in the War in the Middle East on Friday
item.summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said Friday would be the most intense day of the U.S. air campaign in Iran as a vital oil supply route remained choked off.

item.title: U.S. Attacks Iran’s Kharg Island, a Key Port for Oil Exporting, Trump Says
item.summary: The strikes on Kharg Island targeted Iranian military forces, not economic infrastructure on the island, a U.S. military official said.
